question:
Following question consists of 4 figures marked A, B, C and D called the Problem Figures. Select a figure from amongst the Answer Figures which will continue the same series as established by the four Problem Figures.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6742c561cebc02a0a50396ee9371af0695c901005b8a9acacac5cfa193c9e201.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Top-right corner symbol shifts in bottom-left corner and getting reversed (become water image).

Bottom-left corner symbol is replaced by a new symbol as it shifts to Top-right corner position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3dfdb66d3696e3c19942818810047b176bad3d878ff07f4199303bc9bb8c5c85.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
